first_party_reuse.scope: Copy the previously independent first-party arithmetic, physical span and step-option functions as source text; no contributor helper imports.
first_party_reuse.dependency: Bridge receipt is a comparison target, not required at runtime or as a mathematical premise; the local formulas are decided afresh.

domain.transverse_ranks: Each r_i in {0,1,2,3,4}; adjacent differences in {-1,0,1}
domain.signs: Each sign in {-1,0,1}, at most one zero
domain.coordinate_errors: Transverse coordinate at rank r differs from nominal rank by d*eta, eta in [-r,4-r], d=(cos(theta)+sin(theta))*(cos(theta)+sin(theta)-1)
domain.forward_separation: All four pairs have a separating normal in the chain's forward direction.
domain.vertical_frame: Forward coordinate y and transverse rank 4-x; tilt sign unchanged.

expected.excluded_profile_count: Not prescribed; derive all verdicts with complete per-profile evidence.

normal_choice_order.product: Left-to-right Cartesian product of the four step-option lists below, as itertools.product order. Each profile retains one bound id per choice, without early stopping.

exclusion_rule: Every normal choice must have all normalized Bernstein coefficients nonnegative for the trimmed-degree polynomial 2*(1-t^2)*(1+t^2)^2*(lower_span-5) on [0,1/24]. This implies span >=5 and excludes a strict S<5 board; zero polynomial is sufficient. A failed test means not certified by this predicate, not a feasible configuration.
producer_predicate_equivalence: Producer integer Bernstein coefficient k equals 24^degree*binomial(degree,k) times the normalized coefficient, a strictly positive factor; both trim trailing zero power coefficients. No producer program is run.
exposure: Reviewer read the producer theorem, path formulas, full-path generator and positivity implementation in earlier slices and this one. Arithmetic/geometry reconstruction is first-party, partly reused from the independently implemented accepted bridge checker. Not blind and not a second independent implementation relative to that first-party bridge arithmetic.
scope: Complete conditional local general five-tile path classification for 0-4 transverse jumps only. No application to a vacancy/sign case, separation graph enumeration, rule extraction, graph-to-polynomial-bank coverage, unrestricted result or full Stage 4 acceptance.
